gloss: to narrow; to contract; to restrict

definitions.explanation: To reduce the width, space, or range of something.
To reduce the scope or options of something.

examples.japanese: {候補|こうほ}を3{人|にん}に{狭|せば}めた。
examples.english: We narrowed the candidates down to three people.

examples.japanese: {目|め}を{狭|せば}めて{相手|あいて}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: She narrowed her eyes and looked at the other person.

examples.japanese: {包囲|ほうい}{網|もう}を{狭|せば}めていく。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
Pair: {狭|せば}まる (intransitive - to narrow by itself)
Pattern: Xを{狭|せば}める

ASPECT (ている):
{狭|せば}めている - is narrowing (action in progress)
{狭|せば}めてある - has been narrowed (resultant state)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{範囲|はんい}を{狭|せば}める - to narrow the range
・{選択肢|せんたくし}を{狭|せば}める - to narrow the options
・{目|め}を{狭|せば}める - to narrow one's eyes (squinting)
・{包囲|ほうい}を{狭|せば}める - to tighten an encirclement

NOTE:
{目|め}を{狭|せば}める is used when squinting or looking suspiciously at someone.
